payload.summary: The planner and I disagree on whether the crew-role enum should admit implementer.
payload.recommended_default: Keep implementer in the enum and enforce invariant #8 in the Go validator only.
payload.tradeoffs: Keeping it makes the Go rule the sole gate in its fixture's path, so the control stays counterfactual; removing it enforces the rule twice but masks the Go rule, leaving it untested dead code.
